events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, turns 54 today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the legendary Oasis frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US in October 1971, encouraging listeners to envision a world of peace.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Does its message still resonate with you today?

events.title: First iPod unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and changing music consumption forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod arrived 25 years ago? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962, marking 64 years of the iconic spy franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Which 007 actor is your favourite, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, widely known as "The White Album," was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, "The White Album." Which track is your absolute favourite from this legendary record?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, changing the game for pop music. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon on December 8, 1980, a loss that profoundly impacted the music world.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his untimely passing. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally.
